target: Observed source MLC > 0; uncalibrated research scores only

labels.unknown: Missing MLC: exclude with row-level reason; never impute zero
labels.discordant_sequence_pairs: Keep source observations and report disagreement; never majority-vote or collapse without reviewed context
labels.weighting: Primary: original observation rows have equal weight. Prespecified sensitivity: each exact sequence pair has equal total weight in fit and metrics. Report both; never select the favorable result.

host_grouping.rule: Reuse the existing connected-component rule for core distance below threshold or exact assembly identity; recompute and compare archived host membership

phage_grouping.exact_identity: canonical_assembly_digest; all identical sequences share one group

splitting.assignment: Use split_by_host_group ordering independently on each reviewed host/phage group map; no label stratification or seed search
splitting.fit_rectangle: H_train x P_train, minus warm-pair validation/test masks
splitting.warm_pair_mask: SHA256 of UTF-8 seed:host_assembly_sha256:phage_assembly_sha256 modulo 100; 0..4 validation, 5..9 test, 10..99 fit; identical sequence pairs share a mask; fail if any intended seen group disappears from fit
splitting.independent_release_holdout: not_available; a new split of these labels does not create independence

minimal_models.support: seen-phage regimes only; unseen phages explicitly unsupported
seen-phage regimes only; refit existing fixed baseline on the new fit rows, never use all-phage frozen weights
all regimes; published host feature block only
all regimes; canonical phage DNA 4-mer frequencies
all regimes; concatenate the same host and phage blocks; tests paired information, not explicit mechanistic interactions

model_selection.preprocessing: Fit imputation/scaling/category vocabulary on fit rows only; unique entities for entity-level statistics
model_selection.selection_metric: cold_phage validation pooled AP; deterministic lower-C tie break; no test-driven selection
model_selection.seen_phage_only_models: Keep the historical fixed parameters; do not invent unsupported cold-phage scores
model_selection.nonconvergence: fail and report; no silent model or feature change

proposed_phage_features.representation: Canonical DNA 4-mer frequencies; merge each k-mer with its reverse complement using lexical minimum; use the sorted 136-category vocabulary
proposed_phage_features.boundaries: Count within contigs only; skip windows containing non-ACGT bases; divide by the total valid 4-mer count
proposed_phage_features.missingness: Missing sequence or no valid windows is unsupported, never an all-zero biological vector
proposed_phage_features.scope: A compositional baseline, not an RBP, antidefense or causal mechanism representation

metrics: macro per-host/per-phage AP with undefined counts

bootstrap_unit.double_cold: independent host/phage group resampling with multiplicity product
bootstrap_unit.warm_pair: independent host/phage group resampling with multiplicity product

evaluation.interval: paired percentile 95%; discard/report single-class draws, never replace undefined metrics with zero
evaluation.improvement_rule: Primary lower AP-gain bound > 0; insufficient groups/classes means descriptive only; no release or biological-mechanism claim
evaluation.inference_scope: Development intervals conditional on this source/panel; not independent prospective validation

extensions.pretrained_representation: Optional separate experiment after locking checkpoint/tokenizer/pooling/windows/compute budget and pretraining-overlap limitations; no model selected yet
extensions.mechanism_ablation: Remove existing defense and surface blocks separately, then add antidefense/prophage only when annotated and reviewed; use the same admitted rows and treat dataset/condition changes as a new comparison
extensions.calibration_ood: No probability promotion; any later calibration uses validation only and a separate release plan. Unsupported inputs abstain explicitly. Empirical OOD performance remains untested.

before_any_fit: Review and lock phage near-neighbour grouping, beyond exact duplicate assemblies
Review identical-genome label disagreements and freeze retention/weighting policy without majority-vote relabeling
Freeze row-level split IDs, class/group counts, exclusion reasons and common-model cohorts
Lock 4-mer extraction, missingness, exact estimator configuration and environment before inspecting new metrics
Resolve and document dataset reuse terms separately from software licensing
Finalize and version this development protocol; retain a separate future independent release validation plan
